items.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Milt Hinton and Doc Cheatham and people like this, who can tell us things that we don't know first hand.

ctx.x: Okay, tell us how that was for you, you know, providing the facts — helping to provide the facts for a documentary like that.

Well I just did my research, you know, starting with my own experience, my own knowledge of it up to that point, and then you just delve in and read as much as you can and if you’re able to talk to some of the musicians who were there, I think that’s very important. We have some great sources of information and expertise, people that were actually there and did it who are still alive. Milt Hinton and Doc Cheatham and people like this, who can tell us things that we don’t know first hand. Just as I can tell things…

Well thank you so much, and we’re going to kind of wrap up here and thank you for coming and sharing some very precious insights about some of our major icons in this idiom, and we hope that this, not only this taping of this particular session, but the information that you’re telling finds its way into the hearts of students who are interested in this art form.
